observed_gap.reusable_existing_capability: NativeObjectLink::poll_complete_with_progress yields an Option<CompletedMessage> and a bounded-work progress flag.
observed_gap.old_behavior: Native consensus consumer called the Option-only completion API. Hashing received fragments could do real work while returning None, without changing its existing io_progress generation hint.
observed_gap.thin_fix: The existing NativeChannel shared completion helper consumes the progress-aware API and advances io_progress only on real hash progress. Complete object decoding and independent consumer custody still happen at the caller.
observed_gap.unchanged: No timeout, quantum, signature check, protocol decode, quorum, missing-fragment completion, or authorization boundary is disabled.

counterexample.name: native_pipeline::consensus::native::tests::io_hint_tracks_real_hash_continuation_but_not_missing_fragments
counterexample.setup: Existing real authenticated UDP mesh sends a 65-fragment object. One received fragment can advance bounded hash state while object completion stays None. The payload is deliberately invalid as a business object, so eventual decoding must still reject it.

old_ignored_progress.note: Real hash continuation returned incomplete but did not advance the scheduling hint; no fake clock, injected ACK or direct reassembler state establishes this setup.
